newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Ocean stocks plunge on results.
newsitem.headline: Great Ocean stocks plunge on results.

text.p: The share price of China's Shenzhen Great Ocean Shipping Co Ltd plunged in mid-afternoon trading on Thursday, dragging the B index with it, after the company said 1996 profit was 30 percent down on 1995.
The B share was trading at HK$4.05 at 2.35 p.m. (0635 GMT), down HK$0.28 or 6.47 percent on turnover of 1.2 million shares, down from Wednesday's close of HK$4.33.
Great Ocean pulled the Shenzhen B share index down with it by 3.02 percent to 162.6 points in mid-afternoon.

The company's net profit slumped 30 percent to 35.6 million yuan in 1996 from 50.7 million yuan in 1995 according to international accounting standards, a company spokesman told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin.
Trading in the counter was suspended on Thursday morning for the announcement and resumed in the afternoon.
"If Great Ocean's result is affecting the whole market, it will surely have a detrimental affect on its own shares," said a trader at J&A Securities.
